decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of 'The Power of Darkness'. The source documents identify two distinct films with this title: a 1909 Russian film and a 1979 Argentine film. D1S2 explicitly states the 1909 film was 'directed by Chardynin' (Pyotr Chardynin). D4S1 explicitly states the 1979 film was 'directed by Mario Sábato'. While D2S9 mentions Quentin Tarantino in a sentence claiming he 'directed "The Power of Darkness,"', this assertion contradicts the specific factual statement in D1S2 regarding the 1909 film and appears to be an error or hallucination within the provided text (as Tarantino did not direct the 1909 film). Similarly, D3S2 incorrectly attributes the 1909 film to Sergei Eisenstein. Erwin Piscator (C2) directed a stage production of the play, not a film titled 'The Power of Darkness' in the context of the filmography implied by the other candidates. Therefore, the valid directors of films with this specific title found in the text are Pyotr Chardynin and Mario Sábato. The Tarantino claim is treated as a contradiction/error rather than a valid distinct entity for the film director role given the explicit correction in D1S2.
